constraints.description: Students must complete General Education and Writing requirements.
constraints.note: No course list given for GE/Writing requirements.

constraints.source_text: Foundational courses designed to prepare students for the major
constraints.description: Students must complete foundational courses preparing them for the major.
constraints.note: No course list or count given.

constraints.source_text: An introductory 4-unit lower-division (200 level) course in Pharmaceutical and Regulatory Science (RXRS)
constraints.description: Students must complete a 4-unit lower-division RXRS course.
constraints.note: Overlaps with the detailed RXRS 200 requirement listed later in the catalogue.

constraints.source_text: A minimum number of 32 units of upper-division (300 level and above) courses in Biopharmaceutical Sciences (BPSI) and Pharmaceutical and Regulatory Science (RXRS)
constraints.description: At least 32 units of upper-division BPSI/RXRS coursework are required.

constraints.source_text: A minimum of 8 units of upper-division (300 level and above) courses in Biological Sciences (BISC) unique to the major
constraints.description: At least 8 units of upper-division BISC coursework unique to the major are required.

details.filter: level >= 300, subject BISC, unique to major

constraints.source_text: Students must complete a minimum of 36 units of BPSI or RXRS course work, including one 4-unit lower-division RXRS course and a minimum of 32 units of upper-division (300 level and above) BPSI or RXRS course work.
constraints.description: A minimum of 36 total BPSI/RXRS units is required, including one 4-unit lower-division RXRS course and at least 32 upper-division units.

constraints.source_text: A maximum of 4 units can be met by taking Directed Research (BPSI 490x ).
constraints.description: At most 4 units toward the BPSI/RXRS requirement may come from Directed Research (BPSI 490x).

constraints.source_text:
Two courses

- RXRS 200 Approaches to Pharmacology and Drug Development Units: 4
- BPSI 402 Biopharmaceutics I Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must complete RXRS 200 and BPSI 402.

constraints.source_text:
Select one course

- BPSI 407 Pharmaceutical and Health Economics Units: 4
- BPSI 410 Biopharmaceutical Product Development and Brand Planning Units: 4
- BPSI 411 Biopharmaceutical Marketing Analysis and Strategy Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must select one course from the given list.

constraints.source_text:
Select a minimum of four courses

- BPSI 403 Biopharmaceutics II Units: 4
- BPSI 405 Organ Systems Physiology, Drug Delivery and Drug Action Units: 4
- BPSI 406 Drug Safety Pharmacology and Toxicology Units: 4
- BPSI 408 Biologics and Vaccines Units: 4
- BPSI 412 Targeted and Precision Medicines Units: 4
constraints.description: Students must select at least four courses from the given list.

constraints.source_text:
The remaining units may be selected from the following BPSI and RXRS courses, including, but not limited to:

- BPSI 413 Rigor, Resources and Reproducibility Units: 2
- BPSI 414 Pharmacoethics Units: 2
- BPSI 415 Science Talk Units: 2
- BPSI 490x Directed Research Units: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
- RXRS 407 The Discovery, Development and Marketing of Medicines Units: 4
- RXRS 413w Globalization of the Biomedical Industry Units: 4
- RXRS 422 Regulation, Guidance and Control of Medical Products Units: 2
- RXRS 424 From Poisons to Toxicology and Forensic Applications Units: 4
- RXRS 430 Principles of Pharmacy Compounding and Calculations Units: 2
- RXRS 431 Introduction to Patient Care and Clinical Therapeutics Units: 2
constraints.description: Remaining units toward the BPSI/RXRS requirement may be filled from an open-ended pool of listed BPSI and RXRS courses.

details.pool_rule: BPSI and RXRS courses including but not limited to the listed set

constraints.note: Pool is explicitly open-ended ('including but not limited to').

unclassified.source_text: The Bachelor of Science in Biopharmaceutical Sciences requires the completion of a minimum of 128 units
unclassified.why: This is an overall total-degree unit minimum with no filter or pool attribute, so it does not fit the filter-measure-bound pattern of any family.

unclassified.source_text: Students interested in pursuing advanced degrees in pharmacy, medicine, chemistry or dentistry are encouraged to take organic chemistry and/or physics.
unclassified.why: This is an advisory recommendation ('encouraged'), not a binding requirement.

unclassified.source_text: The undergraduate honors in Biopharmaceutical Sciences is awarded through successful completion of the senior capstone project.
unclassified.why: This describes an optional honors track, which is explicitly out of scope per the taxonomy.
